sources.snippet: Hugging Face and Pollen Robotics unveiled Microduck on August 27, 2026 — a $399 25 cm open-source biped with 15 motors, MuJoCo PPO training, and a 50 Hz onboard policy loop.

sources.snippet: Microduck - A duck-like biped robot designed for physical AI experimentation and fun Pollen Robotics and Hugging Face have unveiled the Microduck, a 25 cm tall biped robot with 15 motors, a camera, a depth sensor, two motion sensors, and an articulated beak that can pick up objects.

sources.title: Hugging Face Unveils Microduck: USD 399 Open-Source Robot Targets AI ...
sources.snippet: Hugging Face's USD 399 Microduck is an open-source biped robot with AI training tools, seven pre-trained moves, sensors, and simulation capabilities for developers.

sources.title: Microduck - A tiny biped robot you can teach new tricks | Pollen Robotics
sources.snippet: Microduck is a 25 cm biped robot with 15 motors, a camera, LiDAR and a grasping beak. Playable out of the box, and its open-source stack lets you train new behaviours in simulation and run them on the robot. Pre-order at $399.
